name: Fortalecimento
description: You pump yourself up, increasing your adrenaline. For the duration, add +1 to your damage rolls and AC.
higherLevels: The bonuses gained from this move increases to +2 at level 5, +3 at level 10 and +4 at level 17.

updated.details: No longer requires stacking for full effect. Applies to damage instead of attack rolls.
